question: Will either the Pacific or Atlantic Oceans be renamed by the US federal government by 23:59 UTC on September 30 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if, by 23:59 UTC on September 30, 2026, the US federal government has formally renamed either the Pacific Ocean or the Atlantic Ocean — evidenced by a signed presidential executive order or proclamation directing the use of a new name, or by an official update to the federal Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) adopting a new name for either ocean.
- "No": Wins if no such executive order, proclamation, or official GNIS update renaming either the Pacific Ocean or the Atlantic Ocean has been issued or recorded by 23:59 UTC on September 30, 2026.

Clarifications:
- A "formal rename" requires an actionable federal directive (e.g., a signed executive order or proclamation) or an official GNIS record change; informal remarks, jokes, or proposals by the president or any official do not qualify.
